newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq eased slightly from record high.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq eased slightly from record high.

text.p: Nasdaq shares closed slightly lower Monday, slipping from Friday's record high as investors sold shares to lock in profits, traders said.

The Nasdaq Composite Index lost 1.09 points or 0.08 percent to 1330.93. The Dow gained five points to close unofficially at 6709, a new record. In late trading, the long bond lost 4/32 to yield 6.86 percent.
"It was a busy day, with no consistent message other than some basic profit taking," one trader said. "The slight fall is a none-event compared to the wild swings we've seen lately."
Gainers beat losers 2201 to 2165 on volume of 630 million shares.

Shares of Intel Corp continued their rally, rising 2-3/8 to 146-7/8. The company said Andrew Grove will become chairman in May. Dell Computer Corp gained 1-1/8 to 61-1/8 and Cisco Systems Inc rose 1/2 to 69-1/8.
Shares of Roslyn Bancorp Inc rose five to 15 in their first day of trading. The thrift, which converted from mutual ownership into a stock company, topped the list of the most active Nasdaq stocks.
